_comment: What one device is asked for, module by module, under config/devices/<id>/ where <id> is the device's id. Each named module's own configuration sits beside this file; the hub composes them into the device's desired state and the agent makes each named module match its want. A module not named here is left as it is, and so is one whose want the machine has already satisfied, is_settled: the row goes on saying what was asked and the state names the module no more.
